mythos-router._doc: mythos-router v1.23+ local stdio MCP (SWD file-write receipts + runs inspection) — operator-approved 2026-08-04 after security adjudication (36/36 auditor findings false-positive; execFileSync arg-arrays only, no lifecycle hooks, no telemetry; see vault wiki). Tooling only, same boundary as coinpaprika: the bot's runtime never consumes MCP. Write policy lives in .mythos/policy.json — outputs/**, config.json and .git are BLOCKED (the audit chain, ledgers and guarded config are untouchable by external write tooling), engine trees require operator confirm. Receipts land in .mythos/ (gitignored). The vault wiki remains the knowledge brain (governance rule 12); mythos receipts complement the hash-chained audit trail for agent FILE actions, they replace nothing.
